title: Space Invaders
story: A cache volume is filling up. Three files deny everything, but one of them is visibly avoiding eye contact.
objective: Print the size and name of only the largest file in /var/cache/byteworks.
hints: du -b reports virtual sizes in bytes.
sort -n compares the leading numbers numerically.
explanation: du measures storage use, numeric sort orders sizes correctly, and tail selects the largest result. This pattern scales from a tiny lab to real disk investigations.
